'''One-Man Sand Skimmers''' were small one-man [[Sandskimmer|air vehicles]] used by the [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] military. One example of this craft was left as a derelict outside just outside [[Thall Joben|Thall]] and [[Jord Dusat|Jord's]] [[Ingo speeder shop|speeder shop]] on [[Ingo/Legends|Ingo]]. [[Kea Moll|Kea]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|Threepio]] used the wreck as cover when they came under fire from [[Vlix Oncard]] and the [[Fromm Gang]]'s [[Cloning|Clones]].<ref name="Trigon">{{DroidsCite|The Trigon Unleashed}}</ref> At least one was utilized on [[Tammuz-an/Legends|Tammuz-an]] in a skirmish between the [[Ko Zatec-Cha]] gang and [[Mon Julpa]]'s forces, with [[Jann Tosh]], [[Jessica Meade]], C-3PO and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] being involved.<ref name="King">{{DroidsCite|The New King}}</ref> [[Gaff]] once used one type of this vehicle at the [[Fortress of Tawntoom]] on [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].<ref name="Citadel">{{DroidsCite|The Frozen Citadel}}</ref>

[[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]], the keeper of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] [[Jabba's rancor/Legends|rancor]], used one when he let the rancor out into [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] for some exercise.<ref name="A Boy">{{StoryCite|story=A Boy and His Monster: The Rancor Keeper's Tale|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref> It also saw usage by Jabba's Skiff Guards.<ref name="Offscreen">{{SW|url=news/offscreen-but-not-forgotten-mini-rigs-body-rigs-and-other-kenner-vehicles|text=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|int=Offscreen, but Not Forgotten: Mini-Rigs, Body-Rigs, and Other Kenner Vehicles|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This vehicle, as seen in [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']], was released by [[Kenner Products|Kenner's]] [[Star Wars: The Power of the Force (1985 toy line)|''The Power of the Force'']] toy line in [[1985]] as part of the [[Body-Rigs]] series.<ref name="Offscreen" />
